_notes.lighthouseName: Painted around the tower and shown large on the title. Up to 40 characters.
_notes.playerName: The keeper's name, on the dawn or lost card.
_notes.theme: night (blue-black sea, white beam), storm (purple-grey, heavier rain, more thunder), or dawn (pink horizon, thinner fog, gold beam).
_notes.title: The small line above the lighthouse name. Defaults to Lighthouse Keeper.
_notes.shipsToLose: How many ships on the rocks end the night, 1 to 10. Defaults to 3.
_notes.nightMinutes: Minutes until dawn, 1 to 30. Defaults to 5.
